source.title: Northern Whig, 20 September 1946, p. 3 ("Rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Unopposed nominations from the Northern Whig (20 September 1946, p. 3) and Belfast News-Letter (20 September 1946, p. 3).

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Fourteen members were returned. Glenariff had two nominations, but Joseph Lynn was returned unopposed after the withdrawal of Alexander Stewart; the other divisions were unopposed. Returned unopposed.
